top_signals.title: Oil Prices Plunge as U.S. Elections Shake Up the Iran War
top_signals.summary: December WTI crude oil is headed for one of its roughest weekly losses in months after the market shed $11.37, or 11.10%, from its opening price of $102.39. Prices posted a weekly high at $102.75 before breaking sharply to $86.65. Early Friday, the contract was trading near $91.58, still down heavily for the week. The decline was not driven by a sudden collapse in demand or a surprise rise in inventories. Traders began stripping out a portion of the war premium that lifted prices toward the October highs as U.S. midterm results raised hopes for…

top_signals.summary: Politics, Geopolitics & Conflict Benjamin Netanyahu is using the Shin Bet to challenge an election his bloc lost. All but one of the agency’s election inquiries began after the results showed Netanyahu’s bloc losing. top_signals.title: The Army’s Command-and-Control Reboot
top_signals.summary:
How the Army makes decisions, communicates orders, coordinates forces, and keeps operations moving toward a common goal is undergoing a revolution. It’s called Next Generation Command and Control. Two of its architects — Lt. Gen. Matthew W. McFarlane, commanding general of I Corps, and Maj. Gen. Patrick J. Ellis, commanding general of the 4th Infantry Division — joined us to discuss this important set of organizational and technological innovations.Our thanks to AeroVironment for sponsoring the event at which this episode was recorded.Image: Kathryn Bailey via DVIDS
